rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: Kamal Sandesh reports that the BJP Parliamentary Board meeting of 17 June 2019 'was attended by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, Union Home Minister and BJP National President Shri Amit Shah' and other leaders.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The same report says the party 'appointed former Union Health Minister Shri Jagat Prakash Nadda as its National Working President on 17 June, 2019', by a decision of the Parliamentary Board, and that 'Shri JP Nadda's elevation to the post of Working President is the first of its kind in the history of the BJP'.

locator.section: first paragraph; paragraph containing 'the first of its kind'

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: At the press conference after the meeting, Shri Rajnath Singh said the decision followed 'a formal request from Shri Amit Shah to relinquish his post as BJP National President following his appointment as Union Home Minister', and the report adds that 'Shri Shah has himself requested to be relieved of his duties as BJP President'.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The report says 'Under the current arrangement, Shri Amit Shah will continue to be the party National President and Shri JP Nadda is the Working President', and that 'Shri Amit Shah will continue as BJP President till the organizational elections are over'.

locator.section: 'Under the current arrangement' paragraph; 'As per informations' sentence

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The report recalls that 'Shri Amit Shah had become the Party National President in July 2014', appointed after Shri Rajnath Singh, who 'was the President of BJP in 2014', joined the government as Union Home Minister.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: Under the heading 'JP Nadda takes charge as Working President of BJP' the report describes his welcome at the national headquarters, where 'BJP National President Shri Amit Shah and other senior leaders of the party greeted him with flowers', before he took charge.

locator.section: sub-heading 'JP Nadda takes charge as Working President of BJP'

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The life sketch in the same post lists '17 June, 2019 onwards the BJP National Working President'.

locator.section: LIFE SKETCH, list of positions, last entry
